info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Fixed Asset Register API
info.description: The Fixed Asset Register API provides access to comprehensive details regarding fixed assets within an organization. This service enables users to retrieve information about the assets' status, valuation, and historical records. Typical consumers of this API include financial analysts, asset managers, and compliance officers who utilize the data for reporting and auditing purposes. By facilitating access to essential asset data, organizations can better manage resource allocation and financial planning.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve the complete Fixed Asset Register, which contains detailed information about fixed assets managed within the enterprise. Utilize this operation to access asset records, statuses, and other relevant data for effective asset management.
